production.direction_en: Jori has wedged her compact forge shield beneath the gate. She is too small to hold the door alone, but refuses to step away. Kera arrives on the Guild road with her rebuilt cart.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_tension (hammered anvil hits in the rhythm) | post: bgm_warmth (Jori held the gate)

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: If the gate falls, the forge is next. If the forge falls, they take the tools.

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: You can replace tools. You cannot replace a village.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: I know. That is why I am still standing here.
